fix(studio): record provider HTTP status from wrapped failures (RC156 Win QA #1)

The analysis stage raises `PipelineFailure("ANALYZE", ...) from last_error`,
so an openai 500 lives on __cause__. studio_failure_context only read the
top-level exception, and Windows acceptance recorded failure_stage=analyze
with http_status=null.

- failures.http_status_of walks __cause__ (or __context__ unless suppressed,
  matching traceback) and returns the first int 400-599 http_status /
  status_code; cycle-safe and never reads messages.
- studio_failure_context uses it.
- The timeline stage aggregates chunk reports without an exception chain:
  call_failed chunks now keep http_status and timeline_failure_from_report
  passes it to PipelineFailure(http_status=...).

fix(api): report the package version from /health (RC156 Win QA #3)

/health, /api/health/, /api/v1/health/ and the OpenAPI version were
hard-coded to "1.0.0" while the installed app reported app_version 1.5.6.
Use backend.__version__, which scripts/bump_version.py already keeps in
sync with tauri.conf.json, Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml and the desktop
AUTOCLIP_APP_VERSION fallback. A test checks all three endpoints in desktop
and web mode, plus the desktop fallback contract.

fix(settings): default BasicSettings.app_version to the package version (RC156 Win QA #3)

GET /settings already returns config.app_version; the model default was a
stale "1.0.0" that would surface if the field were ever built without it.

fix(import): classify site refusals (HTTP 403/412/429) as source_blocked (RC156 Win QA #9)

A Bilibili link import from a datacenter IP failed in 4s with HTTP 412; the
generation recorded error_code=unexpected and the UI showed yt-dlp's raw
English text.

- download_recovery: after the existing subtitle / YouTube-format / cookie
  recoveries, a DownloadError with "HTTP Error 403|412|429" raises
  PipelineFailure('INGEST', SOURCE_BLOCKED_HINT, code='source_blocked',
  http_status=N) from None. No extra request, no yt-dlp text/URL/response.
- sentry_setup: source_blocked is a Studio error code and is never sent
  (capture_studio_exception skips it; before_send drops it as a backstop).
- The Chinese hint is an i18n key in all eight locales; ProjectCard now
  translates failure text; analytics/feedback error-code allowlists accept
  source_blocked.
- Tests: recovery classification (412/403/429, YouTube 403 still retries
  the format once, 404/other errors unchanged), Sentry suppression, an
  end-to-end Studio link import recording source_blocked / ingest / 412 in
  Chinese, and a frontend catalog check against the backend constant.
docs(release): fix and re-verify every acceptance finding before tagging; reference the Windows VM harness

chore(scripts): add the Windows installed-package acceptance harness (scripts/winqa)

The SSH-driven harness used for the 1.5.6 Windows acceptance: clean ->
install previous -> seed -> upgrade while running -> API checks -> failure
probes -> CI-equivalent smoke -> logs -> summary, plus opt-in real-model
steps 10-14.

Host, Windows account, SSH identity, model endpoint/model and API key come
only from env vars / CLI args (documented in scripts/winqa/README.md); the
key is passed over ssh stdin and scrubbed from evidence. Evidence defaults
to a directory outside the repository and is git-ignored.

fix(studio): keep project processing until Studio generation settles (RC156 Win QA #8)

Studio runs the content pipeline with clips_only=True and renders afterwards.
process_video_pipeline marked the project completed (or failed) as soon as the
clips were found, so the home page showed 已完成 and stopped polling while
videos were still rendering. clips_only runs now only settle their task row;
Studio owns the project terminal (mark_project / sync_project_completion).
The full legacy pipeline is unchanged.

fix(studio): neighbouring content clips cannot collapse into one draft (RC156 Win QA #7)

Boundary refinement asks the model about each clip separately, so two adjacent
clips could both be 'finished' into the same span (two drafts with an identical
0.0-57.8s scene). A model answer may no longer reach past the neighbouring
clips' original edges (it keeps the sentence-snapped bounds instead), and
_content_drafts drops a lower-scored clip that still overlaps a kept one by
more than half of the shorter clip after falling back to its original range.

fix(whisper): model download says started, falls back to hf-mirror (RC156 Win QA #5, #6)

#5: POST /whisper-models/download answered 模型 X 下载完成 while the download
had only started in a thread, and a later failure was never surfaced. It now
returns 202 {status: downloading} (200 {status: installed} when the model is
already on disk); the status endpoint reports error. Import readiness checks
the selected model, not only the runtime (whisper_model_missing /
whisper_model_downloading / whisper_model_failed), and the import banner can
download it (and chains it after a runtime install). 8 locales updated.

#6: model downloads tried huggingface.co only. Default source 'auto' falls
back to https://hf-mirror.com with hf_xet disabled (xet bypasses the
endpoint); AUTOCLIP_WHISPER_MODEL_SOURCE=huggingface|hf-mirror pins one, a
user HF_ENDPOINT is respected. The used source is recorded. Transcription no
longer lets faster-whisper download a missing model by name; it downloads via
the manager (same fallback) or fails with a 设置 → 转写 hint.

test: make the settings reload test independent of mtime granularity

test_runtime_manager_reloads_connection_document saved the settings document
twice within a few milliseconds. On filesystems with a coarse timestamp tick
(overlayfs here: 196/200 back-to-back writes share st_mtime_ns) the second save
was invisible to the mtime check and the test failed intermittently (2/8 runs
on main). Bump the mtime explicitly; product code is unchanged.

Merge pull request #298 from zhouxiaoka/fix/rc156-batch2

fix: whisper model download status + mirror fallback, distinct content drafts, project status until render (RC156 Win QA #5 #6 #7 #8)

fix(installer): check the app before killing its backend; clear stale backend sources (RC156 Win QA #2, #4)

#4: Tauri's NSIS template runs NSIS_HOOK_PREINSTALL/PREUNINSTALL before its
own CheckIfAppIsRunning. Our hooks killed the bundled python/ffmpeg first, so
when the app could not be closed (user cancels the prompt, or a silent
cross-session install where Restart Manager cannot stop it -> Abort, exit 2)
the app was left running without its backend. The hooks now run
CheckIfAppIsRunning first and only then kill leftover backend processes.

#2: an upgrade only writes this version's files and never prunes
resources\backend, so sources removed in a later version (celery_minimal.py,
...) stayed importable. After the app check and the process cleanup,
PREINSTALL removes $INSTDIR\resources\backend; the template then writes the
new files. User data lives in %APPDATA%\AutoClip and is untouched.

The upgrade smoke now plants a stale file in the old resources\backend and a
user-data sentinel, and asserts the first is gone and the second survives.

Merge pull request #299 from zhouxiaoka/fix/rc156-batch3-installer

fix(installer): check the app before killing its backend; clear stale backend sources (RC156 Win QA #2 #4)

fix(import): refuse too-short and silent sources before any model call (RC156 Win QA #10, #11)

#10: a 10 s talk video spent 5 LLM calls (screening, clip finding, outline,
timeline; 11k tokens) and failed after 108 s with timeline_empty.
#11: a video without an audio track took the subtitle route; local Whisper
raised IndexError and the UI showed "本地 Whisper 生成字幕失败（IndexError）…"
with error_code=subtitle_setup, pointing at transcription settings.

- backend/pipeline/media_precheck.py: one ffprobe call (duration + audio
  streams; unknown never blocks). The subtitle route needs >= one minimum clip
  (profile_for: 20 s for short sources) and an audio track unless an SRT is
  attached. New codes source_too_short / source_no_audio with fixed,
  translatable sentences.
- Studio screening (planning.recommend, shared by the import API, CLI and MCP
  through inspect_project): too-short sources are refused before screening
  unless the user explicitly chose the visual route; silent sources are refused
  before screening when no visual route is possible, otherwise screening is told
  there is no audio track and the run fails only if it still lands on the
  subtitle route. Review plans drop "content" from suggested goals and
  confirm_project refuses the subtitle route for such sources.
- Content pipeline entry (simple_pipeline_adapter) and the legacy import task
  run the same precheck before the LLM preflight / transcription; the legacy
  task raises ImportSourceUnusable (kind source-input).
- generate_subtitle_for_video refuses a silent video before any provider;
  failure_from_speech_error maps it to source_no_audio (no settings hint).
- Whisper UI texts no longer carry internal exception names (generic failure,
  model download failure, runtime import failure); types go to the log only.
- Sentry: both codes are Studio codes in UNREPORTED_STUDIO_ERROR_CODES;
  before_send also drops import_failure=source-input. Frontend/feedback
  error-code allowlists accept them; subtitle failure classification never
  sends them to transcription settings. Sentences in all eight locales.
- Tests: test_media_precheck (probe, codes, screening with/without vision,
  Studio import end-to-end, confirm, pipeline, transcription, Sentry), legacy
  import task, Whisper text, frontend catalog/allowlist and classifier. Tests
  that use the shared 3 s synthetic clip as a normal source opt out of the
  too-short check explicitly.

fix(studio): abort generation on project delete and clear leftover files (RC156 Win QA #12)

Studio has no cancel API; deleting the project is the only abort in the UI.
DELETE during rendering returned 200 and the project/Studio APIs went 404, but
the render kept writing the mp4 (13 s later), then the cover and studio.json
(3 min later). Fourteen minutes later the project directory still held 24 files
/ 9.2 MB. No leftover ffmpeg processes (the encode had already finished).

- backend/core/project_cancellation.py: process-wide cancel set, ProjectDeleted
  (a FileNotFoundError so existing "project is gone" handlers already treat it),
  bind()/checkpoint() for workers, run() for long ffmpeg children (registered so
  cancel() can kill them), and remove_files() that never recreates the directory.
- delete_project_with_files cancels before deleting the DB row / files; restores
  the cancel mark if the delete itself is refused (running Celery task) or rolls
  back. File removal goes through remove_files (retries briefly for locked files)
  instead of the old relative "data/projects/{id}" path and get_project_directory
  (which would recreate the folder).
- Studio workers (_tracked) bind for their whole run and treat ProjectDeleted as
  a quiet stop; the binder clears leftovers after the job exits. store.write /
  change, llm_usage.stage / set_stage / timed, LLMManager.call and vision_call
  checkpoint before spending or writing. llm_usage.usage_path no longer calls
  get_project_directory (that used to resurrect a deleted project). Render uses
  cancellation.run for ffmpeg and refuses to mkdir into a cancelled project.
- Content pipeline (process_video_pipeline + SimplePipelineAdapter) binds and
  checkpoints; ProjectDeleted is not reported to Sentry.
- Tests: cancel/bind/ffmpeg-kill, store refusal, LLM/vision stop, usage never
  recreates the directory, _render mid-delete leaves no mp4/cover, pipeline
  stops before LLM, ProjectService.delete cancelling a live worker, restore when
  a running Celery task blocks delete. Fail-before on origin/main: the same
  mid-render delete left mp4 + cover behind.

fix(usage): keep token accounting writable under a custom usage path

The cancelled-project guard in record/timed skipped writes when the project
directory was missing. Tests (and any custom usage_path) point into a temp
tree that does not yet exist; mkdir there is fine. Cancelled projects still
skip via current_cancelled(), so a deleted project is never resurrected.

Merge pull request #300 from zhouxiaoka/fix/rc156-batch4-media-precheck

fix: refuse too-short/silent sources before model calls; abort generation on project delete (RC156 Win QA #10, #11, #12)

fix(studio): fail runs interrupted by a restart with a readable reason (RC156 Win QA #13)

A Studio run whose worker died with the previous process never finished:
the generation stayed in screening/production, the analysis flag flipped
only in memory (never persisted), and the project index stayed processing
(or completed with 0 clips, before #8) with no reason. A render killed
mid-way (case 4b) settled failed but with an empty project error_message,
and its recovery was also not persisted unless something else wrote.

- store.read recovery now persists every restart recovery and closes
  screening/production runs owned by another process as failed with
  「服务已重启，请重新生成」 / error_code service_restarted (renders: failed
  variants/jobs carry the code; the settled generation gets the reason).
- A live CLI/MCP producer process (generation.producer) is never failed by
  the desktop; a dead one is.
- sync_project_completion recovers interrupted runs before mirroring and
  mirrors the generation's reason/code into the project index;
  ProjectService.latest_failure prefers it over a possibly stale Task row.
- Startup pass (restart_recovery.reconcile_interrupted_projects) closes
  interrupted runs for every smart-import project, including the old
  completed-with-0-clips shape; manual confirmation runs end failed too.
- service_restarted: known Studio code, never reported, whitelisted in
  feedback/workflow analytics and ingest; 4 strings in 8 locales.
- Project card: a failed/partial automatic project offers 「重新生成」, which
  opens the project (existing Studio retry → /studio/{id}/analyze, or
  per-version retry) instead of re-running import screening.

fix(studio): close long-video runs stuck in processing across restarts (RC156 Win QA #13 addendum)

Case 3 (c3-long): the clip_finder call of a 35-min source was killed; after two
restarts the project stayed processing with generation=production and a stale
「正在制作可发布成片」. Any automatic screening/production generation not owned
by a running analysis of this process is now an interrupted run: startup and
the home list close it as failed (service_restarted) and the card offers
「重新生成」.

fix(studio): preview conversion honours project delete; clean orphan project dirs at startup (RC156 PR4 leftovers)

- preview._convert runs bound to the project: ffmpeg goes through
  project_cancellation.run (killed on delete), checkpoints before mkdir and
  before the final replace, never recreates a deleted project directory, and a
  delete is not reported as an encoder failure.
- Startup cleanup removes only directories directly under the projects root
  whose id has no Project row; names must be valid project ids, symlinks that
  resolve outside the root are refused, files are never touched, every removal
  is logged, and any DB read failure removes nothing.

fix(transcription): advance progress by processed audio duration (RC156 Win QA #14a)

A 35:25 source spent ~6 min in local Whisper while the UI only showed the fixed
SUBTITLE checkpoints (overall 10% / 13% / 16%) and Studio kept 「正在制作可发布成片」.

- faster-whisper decodes lazily; every decoded segment now reports
  segment.end / info.duration through backend.utils.transcription_progress
  (a context-scoped receiver; display errors never stop transcription, a
  project delete does).
- The content pipeline shows it: the SUBTITLE sub-step moves smoothly from 25%
  to 40%, and a managed Studio run shows 「正在生成字幕 · N%」 (N = share of audio
  processed), restored to the stage message afterwards. Whole-percent steps,
  at most every 2 s; legacy projects never get Studio state.
- Translate the Studio progress messages that had no catalog entry
  (正在生成字幕, 正在制作可发布成片, 正在生成可发布成片, 正在追加平台版本,
  正在重试成片版本) in 8 locales.

fix(pipeline): show offline/timeout/rate-limit model failures as one clean sentence (RC156 Win QA c5)

The offline failure read 「大纲提取失败：1/1 个文本块调用模型都失败了。最后一次错误：
Connection error. 无法连接模型服务…」: the provider's raw English text was spliced
into the Chinese message, and the composite string matched no catalog entry,
so no other locale could translate it.

- Outline step: connection / timeout / rate_limited failures carry exactly one
  fixed sentence (failures.MODEL_CALL_MESSAGES, shared with the timeline
  hints), translated in all 8 locales. Other all-chunks-failed messages no
  longer include the provider's text either.
- The raw error (type and text) is logged once at warning level.

fix(windows): delete %APPDATA%\AutoClip only when the user asks at uninstall (RC156 Win QA #15)

The template's delete-app-data checkbox only removed the WebView dirs
(com.autoclip.desktop), so projects, settings and API keys (~750MB) stayed
behind, contradicting PRIVACY.md.

NSIS_HOOK_POSTUNINSTALL now removes exactly $APPDATA\AutoClip when:
- not an update (/UPDATE) and not an installer-driven uninstall (_?= in place);
- GUI: the checkbox is ticked (default unticked keeps the data);
- silent/passive: only with an explicit /DELETEAPPDATA.
Custom language files (copied from tauri-bundler 2.10.1, every key kept)
name what the checkbox deletes and add a confirm-page note; PRIVACY and the
install guide (zh/en) match.

fix(clip-finder): smaller windows and a context hint for local models (RC156 Win QA #14b)

Local servers (Ollama, LM Studio, a local/LAN compatible endpoint) usually
run with a 4-8K context and silently drop the start of a long prompt; the
35-minute Win QA transcript went out as one ~46K-token request.

simple-progress bar percent.

fix(desktop): backend exits when the app is gone, even after kill -9 (RC156 #20)

macOS has no Job Object: after kill -9 of the app the bundled backend kept
running as an orphan (Mac RC2 14:22). The Tauri shell now passes its PID in
AUTOCLIP_PARENT_PID; desktop_main watches it (reparent on POSIX, psutil
start-time check everywhere, so PID reuse is safe) and, once the app is
gone, terminates its child processes (ffmpeg, Whisper/SenseVoice runtimes),
stops uvicorn, closes pooled DB connections and exits 0. studio.json writes
are already atomic and restart recovery settles interrupted generations.

Opt-in only: CLI, MCP, Docker and dev runs have no AUTOCLIP_PARENT_PID and
are not watched; the variable is consumed so our own children never inherit
it. On Windows the Job Object still owns the tree; the watch is redundant there.

Tests include a real kill -9 of a parent process with a backend stand-in and
an ffmpeg-like child (POSIX).

fix(installer): uninstall removes runtime leftovers so the install dir goes (RC156 #23)

Every uninstall left resources\python\Lib\encodings\__pycache__\gbk.cpython-313.pyc:
the Tauri template only deletes the files it installed and then RMDirs each
directory non-recursively, so one runtime .pyc kept the whole
resources\python\... chain and the install dir.

NSIS_HOOK_POSTUNINSTALL now, on a real uninstall only (not /UPDATE, not the
installer's pre-install uninstall where $EXEDIR == $INSTDIR, and only once the
template removed the main exe), recursively removes the three bundled
resource dirs (resources\python, backend, ffmpeg - exactly the
tauri.windows.conf.json resources) and then RMDirs resources and $INSTDIR
non-recursively. Nothing outside $INSTDIR is touched; %APPDATA% stays governed
by the delete-data option.

Rendered tauri-bundler 2.10.1 installer.nsi with these hooks compiles with
makensis 3.11 -WX.

fix(installer): silent /DELETEAPPDATA deletes the same data as the GUI checkbox (RC156 #24)

uninstall.exe /S /DELETEAPPDATA removed %APPDATA%\AutoClip but left the WebView
data in %LOCALAPPDATA%\com.autoclip.desktop: the template's delete block only
runs for the ticked GUI checkbox. The hook's single removal block (reached by
the ticked checkbox or by silent/passive /DELETEAPPDATA) now deletes the same
three directories: %APPDATA%\AutoClip, %APPDATA%\com.autoclip.desktop and
%LOCALAPPDATA%\com.autoclip.desktop, each guarded by non-empty shell folder +
FileExists. Still never on /UPDATE or the installer's pre-install uninstall.
